book.name: Matthew
book.title: Retir̃uhu Hin Iesu Kr̃isto Matthew Mo Ulia

content: Pin Iesu
Reti nike mo vereuli na pin Iesu Kr̃isto, mahapin Abraham enia Supe David.
Abraham enia taman Isaac. Isaac enia taman Jacob, ale Jacob enia taman Judah tolu na voraina,
Judah enia taman Perez peresi Zerah, ale tinara Tamar, Perez enia taman Hezron, ale Hezron enia taman Ram,
Ram enia taman Amminadab, Amminadab enia taman Nahshon, ale Nahshon enia taman Salmon,
ale Salmon enia taman Boaz, ale tinana Rahab, Boaz enia taman Obed, ale tinana Ruth, ale Obed enia taman Jesse,
Jesse enia taman Supe David, Supe David enia taman Solomon, ale tinana Bathshiba enia malepun Uriah sei,
Solomon enia taman Rehoboam. Rehoboam enia taman Abijah, ale Abijah enia taman Asaph,
Asaph enia taman Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat enia taman Joram, Joram enia pin Uzziah,
ale Uzziah enia taman Jotham, Jotham enia mahapin Ahaz, ale Ahaz enia taman Hezekiah,
Hezekiah enia taman Manasseh, Manasseh enia taman Amos, ale Amos enia taman Josiah,
Josiah enia pin Jechoniah tolu na tahisana, enira hasera purongo natu la pa lo mauri hin pongi atu mara Babylon la tauri na tavtavuin Israel la lavira la vano Babylon. 2 Ki 24.14–15
Hitahun rani atu mara Babylon la lavira la vano, ale pina mo vano sohen harihi: Jechoniah enia taman Shealtiel, ale Shealtiel enia taman Zerabbabel,
Zerabbabel enia taman Abiud, Abiud enia taman Eliakim, ale Eliakim enia taman Azor,
ale Azor enia taman Zadok, Zadok enia taman Achim, ale Achim enia taman Eliud,
Eliud enia taman Eleazar, Eleazar enia taman Matthan, ale Matthan enia taman Jacob,
ale Jacob enia taman Joseph, Joseph enia tuan Mary, ale Iesu mo vora isan Mary, enia haratu la tovia Kr̃isto.

Ale mo sohena natu, pin Abraham mo tikeli Supe David mo tikeli 14, ale pin Supe David mo tikeli rani atu la vano Babylon mo tikeli 14, ale pina hin rani atu tamlohi la vano Babylon mo tikeli na rani Kr̃isto mo vora mo tikeli 14.
Pongi Vora Non Iesu
Ale reti vora non Iesu nor̃a Kr̃isto mo sohen harihi: Tinana Mary, la tapuhia vara i pa naroun Joseph, pani la sopo lo lahi pani o er̃i hitea vara Mary mo tau natuna moiso na suihan Tanume Tapu.
Joseph sei enia i pa tuan Mary, ale matan enia tamlohi vokevoke matea, mo sopo opoia vara i vai Mary i mahanuhanu, ale mo aleale malele vara i tinar̃ihia, ale tea la pa sopo levosahia.

Pani Joseph mo pa lo r̃omr̃omia, ale vahatea purongo, angelo non Moli God matea mo pala isana na mavuho, ale mo verea mara, “Joseph pin David, o sopo matahu vara o lavi Mary naroum. Hina rihirihi sei na lolona mo tai isan Tanume Tapu.
I pa vasusui na natirihi lamane matea, ale o pa tau na hijana vara Iesu matan enia i pa juri na nona tamlohi na nora hehe.”
La hinau nike, la masese matan vara i mar̃ivisi na sava Moli God mo verea isana pr̃ovet tuai sei mara,

content.text: ‘Eh! Har̃ai maevo matea i pa pangepange, ale i pa vasusui na natuna lamane matea.
La pa tau na hijana vara Immanuel.’

content: R̃aramin hija atu enia, ‘God mo lo toho isar̃a’.
Hitahuna Joseph mara mo turu, mo vai na sava angelo atu non Moli God mo lo verea, ale mo lavia narouna,
pani mo sopo juruvi peresia mo mai mo tikeli na rani mo vasusui na natuna lamane matea, ale mo tau na hijana vara Iesu.
